products.name: Windows Firewall Management — Commercial
products.short_description: Enforce the host firewall fleet-wide with default-deny inbound. Do it yourself with self-guided, tested steps for a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
A consistently enforced host firewall across the entire fleet

The host firewall is the last line of defense on every endpoint — but on unmanaged fleets it is often disabled, inconsistently configured, or full of stale rules. This solution manages Windows Defender Firewall centrally through Intune: on across every profile, default-deny inbound, standardized rules, and full state reporting.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant on site to deploy Windows Firewall Management. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation that a non-expert administrator can follow from start to finish — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that do the heavy lifting. You implement with confidence, on your own schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short and uncluttered.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation scripts and clear pass/fail gates, so you know it worked before you roll out to the fleet.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — Intune-managed firewall policy explained.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite with verify/implement steps.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered Intune steps: profiles on, default actions, and managed rules.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — firewall discovery, validation, rule reporting, remediation, and conflict checking.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices.

The Phoenixtekk way

Every Phoenixtekk solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The firewall on for every profile, default-deny inbound, a single managed rule set instead of per-device drift, and fleet-wide visibility — the highest-value host posture, consistently enforced.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WFM-ConflictCheck.ps1 — list Intune firewall policies and assignments to spot conflicts
    • WFM-Discovery.ps1 — report Windows Defender Firewall state and rule counts
    • WFM-Remediation.ps1 — re-enable firewall profiles and force a policy sync
    • WFM-RuleReport.ps1 — list effective Windows Firewall rules on the device
    • WFM-Validation.ps1 — confirm all firewall profiles are enabled with default-deny inbound

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
